title: Question to the person
description: issues/<id>/library/questions/<n>.json, where n is the number the ledger gave the question. Written by whoever asks. A command checks it, renders the person's text from it and runs `kanban ask`. Only these keys.

kind.description: Which of the five decision kinds (line is a change to the line), or scope: which candidates a fix issue should fix. A scope question goes to the Chief of Staff and does not light the andon.

facts.description: Facts, as paths or URLs rather than copies. A question outside the delegation has one line naming the delegation it is outside of.

options.description: Two or more options. The first one is the recommendation (pick: true); no other option has pick: true.

pick.description: Only the first option is picked.

remaining.description: How many questions follow this one.

pick.description: true only on the recommended option.
